data.no_file_impact_reason: Analysis and a criterion proposal, not an implementation. The deliverable is a recorded ruling on P0-P3 (adopt / adopt-narrowed / reject). Any source change — building import-integrity or ci-gate-compat, widening code-review-surface-parity or T13, or adding a project.obligation-parity overlay — belongs to the follow-up ticket the ruling authorises, which will carry its own file impact. If the ruling is 'reject', the only edit is a documentation note in docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md and docs/plan-review-gate.md recording why.
